classification.difficultyReason: Students convert the supplied exponential rule into a table and curve, interpret the initial value, and subtract two populations. The hardest demand is reversing the graph reading to estimate when the population exceeds 1000 and rounding the crossing time; the supplied table inputs and axes scaffold these routine linked procedures.

content.prompt: The exponential function, $N = 6^{t}$, is used to model the growth in the number of insects ($N$) after $t$ days.

inlines.text: Fill in the table and sketch the curve.

answer.worked: Read across from $N=1000$ to the curve, then down to the $t$-axis. The crossing occurs at approximately $t=3.9$ days, to 1 decimal place. The number of insects exceeds 1000 after this crossing.
